what: Full-screen bands in red, green, blue and white drift slowly, and pushing with the mouse makes a fluid (velocity field fed back across two render targets) bend the bands, leaving a swirl trail where the cursor passed that then cools off (WebGL). A 25px brush around the cursor segment adds force 10 in the direction moved (max 10px per frame), decays by .98 each frame, and when the cursor stops only the area around it settles faster at .85x. 60fps (phone 30fps · .75x resolution · .7x brush).

options.brush: Brush size (px, based on simulation resolution), default 25
options.decay: Share of speed kept each Frame, default .98
options.stop: Extra cooling around where the cursor stopped, default .85
options.warp: How far the band is pushed per unit of fluid speed, default 1
options.c1 · c2 · c3 · c4: Four colors (three numbers from 0 to 1, 「1 0 0」) — default red, green, blue, white

note: The CommonJS build of three (three.cjs) loads _fx/pillar-gallery-gl/three-global.js first and uses it as window.THREE. The original covered the top and bottom of the panel with background-color masks so only a thin band in the middle showed (css on the using side). The shaders were not ported from the original but newly written with the same values (brush · force · cooling · hold)
